newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria mudslide hits 20 houses, no one hurt.
newsitem.headline: Austria mudslide hits 20 houses, no one hurt.

text.p: Twenty houses were buried when a rain-swollen stream burst its banks and set off a mudslide early on Sunday in the Austrian province of Tyrol, but no one was injured, Austrian state television reported.
It said the fire brigade had to free some families from their sludge-barricaded houses in the Lienz suburb of Nussdorf-Debant.
